claim.quote: MOSCAB equipment, a geyser-concept bubble-chamber originally thought for the search of dark matter in the form of WIMPs, is employed for the detection of fast neutrons.

name: Effective exploitation of a geyser bubble-chamber equipment as a background-free fast neutron detector

summary.plain: The MOSCAB bubble-chamber equipment, built to search for dark matter, is used instead as a detector of fast neutrons that ignores other radiation.
summary.technical: Operated background-free when the nucleation threshold for neutrons is above about 2.5 MeV; response studied with an AmBe source and Monte Carlo efficiency functions. A neutron-detection paper, not a dark matter result; recorded because it is the source for the move of the apparatus to LNGS.

title: Effective exploitation of a geyser bubble-chamber equipment as a background-free fast neutron detector
why_it_matters: The abstract considers use for weak neutron sources in clean environments and for monitoring cosmic-ray variations.
